answer: Throttle new identities through a scarce admission queue like boats at a jetty: the network issues only a handful of identity credentials per epoch, and each applicant holds one public queue ticket, renewing a liveness proof every epoch. A duplicated, transferred, or idle ticket drops out and forfeits its deposit, so bulk farming fails. An attacker wanting a thousand fakes must occupy a thousand scarce slots across many epochs, paying deposit and wait on each, while honest agents sign their applications like a quill on a ledger. The queue moves at a sonnet's steady meter: sybils cannot hurry.
